decision: Keep rooms, commands, Streamer.bot integration, leaderboards, and Phasmophobia analytics application-owned.
reason: These are domain-specific workflows under the Kaizen Platform ownership contract.

decision: Move the generic bug-report and feature-request receiver to Kaizen Platform Host and consume it by URL contract.
reason: Support intake is reusable technical infrastructure and can serve applications implemented in different runtimes.

decision: Keep the existing Phasmo report route as a standalone fallback.
reason: Kaizen applications must remain independently useful when the optional Platform support runtime is unavailable.
